authority: provider roles are bounded retrieval/provenance capabilities, never evidence promotion
failure_semantics: provider failure, timeout, quota, denial, or empty response produces a provider-health event and does not become a no-literature conclusion
independence_rule: one provider cannot silently substitute for another provider's identifier, rights, correction, or retraction role

forbidden_uses: treating a work record as evidence
inferring no literature from a failed request
treating a DOI as proof of a claim
assuming license scope from a missing field

allowed_uses: open-access status as a discovery signal
forbidden_uses: treating OA status as a license grant
using provider coverage as a completeness claim
generalizing biomedical index coverage to all fields
using an absent record as no-literature evidence
